theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_ehs_del_rhs_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (ζ g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ContinuousOn g U → Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ∫ x in U, inner ℝ (h⁻¹ • (ζ x - ζ (x - h • e))) (g x)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (∫ x in U, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ x e) (g x)))
